Dear Netcompany Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Application Support Agent role. With a technical background in web development and digital marketing, and hands-on experience supporting users and managing web applications, I am confident I can contribute to your team supporting EU institutions.

In my current roles, I build and maintain WordPress sites, troubleshoot technical issues, and ensure smooth user experiences. I have worked with ticketing and project tools like Jira, and I am comfortable diagnosing and resolving basic technical problems. My experience with Microsoft Office 365 and web technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) aligns with the role's requirements. I am eager to apply my skills to support EUDR and waste shipment notifications, and to grow within Netcompany.

I am fluent in English and have a customer-centric mindset. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to your team.

Best regards,

cover_letter:
Dear Netcompany Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the Application Support Agent position at Netcompany. With a technical foundation in computer science and practical experience in web development and digital marketing, I am drawn to Netcompany's mission of responsible digitalisation and its work with EU institutions. I believe my blend of technical troubleshooting and user-focused support makes me a strong fit for this role.

In my current freelance and junior digital marketer roles, I build and maintain websites, diagnose technical issues, and ensure seamless user experiences. I have worked with ticketing and project management tools such as Jira, and I am proficient in Microsoft Office 365. My background in front-end development (AngularJS, JavaScript) and web technologies (HTML, CSS) gives me a solid understanding of web applications and databases, which I can apply to resolving access and validation errors. I am also detail-oriented and analytical, skills I have honed through SEO audits and content management, where precision is critical.

While I have not worked directly with EU environmental regulations, I am a quick learner and eager to deepen my knowledge of EUDR and waste shipment processes. My experience collaborating with clients and team members has taught me the importance of clear, non-technical communication—a key aspect of this role. I am fluent in English and comfortable working in diverse, international environments.

I am enthusiastic about the opportunity to support Netcompany's projects and contribute to impactful digital services. Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how my skills align with your needs.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
cv_highlights:
• Front-End Developer at ViviDoctor: developed and optimized features for a healthcare web application using AngularJS and JavaScript, gaining hands-on experience with web application troubleshooting.
• Web & SEO Specialist at Knowledge Experts: supported building SharePoint-based digital workplace sites for large clients, ensuring smooth integration and user experience.
• Freelance SEO & WordPress: designed, built, and maintained multiple websites, diagnosing technical issues and managing content—demonstrating attention to detail and analytical skills.
• Proficient with Microsoft Office 365 and ticketing/project tools like Jira; comfortable with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and basic database concepts.
• Fluent in English with a customer-centric mindset; experienced in collaborating with clients and teams to provide clear, non-technical guidance.
